items.suggested_title: Ceiling water damage: how to read the stain, and when the ceiling has to come down
items.notes: Highest-volume uncovered term from the seed family (3,600/mo, KD 0, $44.85 CPC) and no blog post touches it. Lead with the three-stain triage a homeowner can do from the floor: colour, spread, and whether the drywall is sagging. Anchor locally: in Royse City, Rockwall and Fate the usual cause is a hail-punctured roof or a failed attic air-handler pan, not a burst supply line, because these are slab-on-grade houses with the AC sitting over finished space. In Lakewood and the M Streets a ceiling stain more often means a century-old cast-iron stack in a pier-and-beam house. Give the sag-and-bulge safety cutoff (do not poke a bulging ceiling, it is holding standing water) and hand off to the water damage restoration page.

items.suggested_title: Hardwood floor water damage: what can be dried and saved, and what has to come out
items.notes: 1,600/mo, KD 0, uncovered. The decision homeowners actually want made for them is dry-in-place versus tear-out, so structure the post around cupping vs crowning vs buckling and the moisture-content thresholds a tech reads with a meter. Local hook: DFW hardwood is usually engineered plank glued to a slab, which traps water underneath and hides it from a surface reading, so the post should explain why a floor that looks fine on top can still be a total loss. Mention the 24-48 hour mold window and route to mold remediation.

items.suggested_title: Water damage baseboard repair: what the trim is telling you about the wall behind it
items.notes: Combined uncovered cluster worth roughly 5,000/mo at KD 0 (baseboard 1,300, wall 880, drywall 590 + 880 repair). Swelling or dark-staining baseboard is the single most common early tell of a slab leak in this market, so make the post the diagnostic: swollen MDF trim, soft drywall at 2-4 inches, a warm spot on the floor. Explain flood cuts and why a restoration firm removes trim and drills the wall cavity instead of just repainting. Ties to general contracting for the rebuild.

items.notes: 590/mo, KD 27, $45.19 CPC. IMPORTANT boundary: the site already has /blog/does-homeowners-insurance-cover-water-damage/, which answers whether a loss is covered.
